message.content: On July 7th, 2026, LiHua expressed concern about potential issues in the basement following recent rainstorms, asking Adam whether there were any problems that needed attention. Adam assured her that everything seemed fine, though he advised LiHua to keep an eye on the area and notify him if she observed anything unusual. He mentioned that he would send a maintenance worker to inspect the basement if necessary. This conversation highlights LiHua and Adam's shared responsibility for ensuring the safety and proper functioning of the basement, particularly after experiencing rainfall that might have caused some structural or utility-related issues.
